tei:div.tei:p: (shrī)༄༅// grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i byin rlabs bya tshul gsal bar bkod pa mchog gi byin rlabs ye shes bcud sbyin zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// 'phags yul grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga ji ltar bgyid pa'i tshul gsal bar bkod pa mchog gi byin rlabs ye shes bcud sbyin zhes bya ba/ dpag tu med pa'i thugs rje mnga' ba'i rtsa ba'i bla ma yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zung 'jug bde chen sku brnyes pa'i// grub mchog bla ma brgyud par 'dud// gang gi byin rlabs byed tshul ni// bla ma'i gsung bzhin gsal bar dgod// de yang gnas khang byi dor byas par stegs bu khebs ldan gyi dbus/ maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa dbus zlum dkar po pad+ma 'dab brgyad mdzes tshon/ gru chad phyogs mdog tu btang ba'i dbus su me tog tshom bu bkod/ mtha' mchod pas bskor/ mdun ngos nang mchod tshogs gtor bcas bsham/ nyin dang por bum pa tshad ldan bcud kyis gang ba yang 'du bya/ slob dpon gyis bla med kyi yi dam yab yum gang rigs kyi bdag bskyed dang ldan pas nang mchod gnas yo byin rlabs bya/ rje grol mchog zhabs sogs kyis slob dpon gyis sgrub pa'i tshul dmigs bsal ma gsungs kyang bla ma'i phyag bzhes la mdzad pas/ 'og nas 'byung bzhin slob ma la dmigs pa ngo sprod pa ltar slob dpon rang nyid kyis tshar gcig nyams su blang*/ de nas slob ma rnams bos la khrus byas/ me tog bkye bsdu grub mtshams 'di ltar brjod par bya'o// nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i gong 'phang mngon du bya/ de'i ched du 'phags yul grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i byin rlabs dbang bskur zhu snyam pas ma yengs par gsan 'tshal/ de yang rgyal ba rnams kyis bstan pa'i dam pa'i chos tshul mtha' yas kyang mdor bsdu na theg pa dman mchog gnyis su 'du ba las/

theg dman nyan rang gi theg pa las chos dang*/ sems dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ mos pa dang*/ tshogs dang*/ dus dang*/ sgrub pa chen po ste chen po bdun gyis theg pa chen po zab cing*/ theg pa chen po de nyid la'ang rgyu dang 'bras bu'i theg pa gnyis su dbye ba'i 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa nyid mchog tu gyur par bshad de/ tshul gsum sgron me las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang*// thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang*// dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas nas// sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags// zhes sogs mang du gsungs shing*/ theg pa chen po de las lam gyis yon tan thams cad kyi rtsa ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshul bzhin bsten pa la rag las par gsungs shing*/ mdo sdud pa las/ slob ma bzang po bla mar gus ldan de dag gis// bla ma mkhas pa rnams la yongs su bsten par bya// ci phyir zhe na mkhas pa'i yon tan de las 'byung*// zhes dang*/ khyad par rdo rje'i theg pa las ni che thang du bsngags te he badz+ra las/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus thabs bsten pa dang*// bdag gis bsod nams las shes bya// zhes dang*/ rgyud gzhan las kyang*/ yon tan rgya mtsho bla ma la// dang ba'i yid kyis mchod byas na// mchog dang thun mong thams cad kyi// dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur// ces gsungs pa sogs kyis mtshon la/ skal ldan dbang po yang rab 'ga' zhig byin rlabs kyi stobs kyis skad cig la grol ba yang bla ma'i thugs rje dang slob ma'i mos gus 'dzom pa las byung ba yin la/ byin gyis rlobs tshul ni mtha' gcig tu ma nges te spros bcas spros med kyi tshul can dbang dang rjes gnang ci rigs pas so// dpon slob kyi rten 'brel 'dzom na bla mas tshig gcig ma bstan/ slob mas tshig gcig ma nyan kyang*/ lta stangs sam phyag spyi bor bzhag pa'am brda tsam gyis grol ba yod de/

slob dpon til+li pa nā ro pas dka' ba chen po bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas bsten pa'i mthar/ til+li pas mchil l+h+wam dpral bar brgyabs pas brgyal/ brgyal sangs pa na chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs mngon sum du gzigs pa lta bu ste/ des mtshon 'phags bod kyi yul du slob dpon 'ga' zhig de ltar brda dang dgongs pa gtad pas grol ba byung tshul so so'i rnam thar du gsal ba bzhin no// de las 'dir 'phags yul grub brnyes brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i byin rlabs kyi rim pa sgrub par byed pa la/ de yang gsang sngags kyi theg pa bla na med pa'i skabs 'dir dbang bzhi'i don tshang yang dbang gi cho ga dngos ma yin zhing cho ga'i rim pa yang shin tu zor yang ba rnams la byin rlabs kyi cho ga zhes rdo rje slob dpon chen po rnams la grags pa ltar/ byin rlabs kyi cho ga dbang bzhi'i tshul can bgyid pa la/ de yang bdag cag gi ston pa'i bstan pa 'di nyid la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas nyan thos sde pa rnams la grags pa'i bka' bsdu gsum pa zin pa'i mjug theg chen gyi sde snod thog mar dar ba dang dus mtshungs par slob dpon bram ze chen po sa ra ha byon pa nas bzung ste/ dus phyis mkhas pa sgo drug yan chad kyi dus tsam du byon pa'i rdo rje theg pa rnal 'byor chen po'i lam la brten nas dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon grags che ba rnams te/ de yang brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i grangs nges kyi tha snyad la ngos 'dzin tshul mang yang*/ bod 'dir sngon slob dpon rdo rje gdan pas mdzad par grags pa'i bstod pa tshigs bcad du sdebs pa 'di la mkhas pa'i dbang po ches che ba dag gis kyang dpyad pa med par tshad mar mdzad cing*/ byings mkhas rmongs ma lus pas tshad thub yin khul mdzad mod kyang*/ phyis byon grub chen nag po spyod pa'i rnam 'phrul rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog zhabs dang*/ gang gi yang srid rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa tā ra nā tha'i zhabs sogs 'phags yul gyi mkhas grub dang thugs 'dris che zhing sngon gnas rjes su dran pa'i dam pa tshad mar gyur pa dag gi gsung ltar na/

rgya gar gyi phyogs su sngon nas da bar bstod pa 'di gang du'ang ma grags pas/ bar skabs bal po'i lha bzo ba zhig gis rdo rje gdan pa la kha g.yar te brtsams par grags pa don la gnas shing*/ bstod pa der brjod don la gzhigs kyang nor 'khrul mang ba sogs yid brten med cing*/ paṇ+ḍi ta dpa' bo 'od gsal gyi lugs 'di nyid rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du snga phyir grags pa dang mthun zhing rtogs brjod/ do ha/ byin rlabs kyi rgyun dang bcas pa tshad thub ma nyams par gnas pas 'di 'ba' zhig khungs su 'os zhes bzhed pa mkhas grub dam pa chen po'i rdo rje'i gsung dpang du gyur par nges pa rnyed pas 'di'i dbang du byas te bshad na/ sngon byung gi lo rgyus ni/ sngon dus dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal du gnod sbyin mo zhig las kyi dbang gis dur khrod kyi mi ro rul pa za zhing gnas pa las/ nam zhig na nam mkha' nas gnod sbyin gzhan gyis de'i lus kyi steng du khro chu khol ma blugs pas lus thams cad tshig ste sdug bsngal bzod blag med par gyur pa la/ grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhis gnod sbyin mo de yang skal ba dang ldan par mkhyen cing tshad med pa'i thugs rje chen pos de'i don du snying po'i don ston pa'i man ngag rin chen phreng ba zhes pa mdzad de/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ko ki la dang dharma bi shwa zhes pa gnyis la gdams/ de gnyis kyis gnod sbyin mo la gdams pa bstan pas lus kyi zug rngu zhi/ sems rgyud rnam par grol te bden pa mthong ba'i mkha' 'gro ma chen mor gyur skad/ dus phyis rgya gar nub phyogs su'u rāṣ+ṭa'i bye brag kān+ta ma ra zhes bya bar chos ldan gyi rgyal po kuñdzi zhes pa rgyal srid chos bzhin skyong ba zhig yod pa las nam zhig na de'i ma na ste 'chi bar nye ba na/ rgyal po de ma la brtse bas/ ma khyed yun ring du mi bzhugs pa 'dra na sku tshe phyi mar phan pa'i thabs su dge slong gi dge 'dun dang*/

bram ze dang*/ lha khang mchod pa dang*/ sbyin pa gtong ba la sogs pa ci 'dod pa bdag gis bya yis bka' stsol cig ces smras pas/ ma na re/ kho mo'i dge rtsa gzhan bya mi dgos kyi grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo brgyad cu rtsa bzhi spyan drangs la tshogs kyi 'khor los mchod de nga'i don du gsol ba thob cig zer nas 'das so// der rgyal po'i bsam pa la/ sngon gyi grub thob de dag ni da lta mi'i 'gro ba tha mal pas mi mthong na ji ltar spyan drang*/ 'on kyang ma'i ngag bcags na mi rung zhing grub chen rnams thugs rje'i bdag nyid yin pas gsol ba gdab par bya'o snyam nas gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pa na ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ko ki la dang*/ dharma bi shwas mngon sum du zhal bstan te nged gnyis kyis khyod kyi grogs bya ste grub thob rnams spyan drang gi tshogs khang rtsigs shig gsungs/ der rgyal pos tshogs khang rgya chen po brtsigs/ mkha' 'gro ma gnyis kyis rdzu 'phrul gyis skad cig la gnas so sor byon te grub thob rnams spyan drangs pas/ dang por lū yi pa byon/ de nas rim bzhin grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi skad cig la byon te gdan la bzhugs pa la/ rgyal pos tshogs kyi yo byad gya nom pa bshams te tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i 'du ba yun ring du mdzad/ mthar grub thob rnams rgyal po'i mchod gnas su yun du bzhugs par zhus kyang ma gnang*/ grub thob re res do ha rdo rje'i glu re blangs te gar gshegs cha med par bzhud/ der rgyal pos sku tshab tu grub thob so so'i sku re bzhengs/ de'i mdun du so so'i do ha rnams yi ger bris te mchod pa byas so// de'i tshe shar phyogs kyi thag ring po nas brgyud nas paṇ+ḍi ta dpa' bo 'od gsal zhes bya ba zhig gis rgyal po kuñdzi'i mchod gnas su grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi dngos su byon te zhes thos nas bsnyegs te byon pas grub thob rnams zin nas zhag bdun lon pa dang 'grig

gdung shugs drag pos sa the btsugs nas gsol ba btab pas zhag bdun song ba na/ mkha' 'gro ma gnyis kyis zhal mngon sum du bstan te do ha dang rin chen phreng ba sogs kyi gdams pa lo rgyus dang bcas pa stsal/ de'i don nyams su bzhes pas rtogs pa khyad par can brnyes te grub pa'i dbang phyug tu gyur/ do ha thor bu rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i glegs bam yang mdzad/ de nas rim bzhin brgyud de yul tsam+pa r+ṇar 'khrungs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i dpal gyi bar du byon/ des do ha'i 'grel pa rnam thar dang bcas pa mdzad/ de thams cad phyogs gcig tu paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang*/ mi nyag lo tsā ba smon grub shes rab yab sras kyis bod 'dir bsgyur zhing 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab nas dar rgyas su mdzad pa yin cing*/ do ha rnam thar gnyis sngon gyi bstan 'gyur du sdud pa po mkhyen ldan kun gyis khungs thub tu bzhag nas/ dbus gtsang gi bstan 'gyur yongs la bzhugs pa'i rtsod med yid ches can yin la/ rjes gnang gi yi ge rnying pa phal cher na slob ma grub thob gang yin du bskyed pa dang*/ mtshan sngags dang 'bru gsum bzlas par bzlas lung len pa sogs 'jug kyang*/ 'dir rje grol mchog zhabs kyi bzhed pas bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi tshul du phyag mchod sngon du 'gro bas grub thob de dang de'i byin rlabs don gyi 'pho ba dbang bzhi'i tshul can du bskur bar bzhed pa ltar sgrub par byed pa la/ thog mar sgo 'byed kyi tshul du rtsa ba'i bla ma'i dbang bzhi sgrub pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug de nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal 'di nyid rtsa ba'i bla ma gang du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i zhing khams rgya khyon tshad med pa ngo mtshar gyi bkod pa 'byams su klas zhing*/ rang snang mchod pa'i sprin phung gtibs pa'i dbus su/ seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du dus gsum sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rje btsun rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog in+d+ra nī la'i phung po ltar sngo zhing 'od zer 'bar ba/

shin tu zhi zhing mtshan dang dpe byad gsal la rdzogs pa/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol stabs su 'dzin cing rang snang shes rab mchog gi bde bar spyod pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ dran pa tsam gyis bde ba chen po'i ye shes skyed par nus pa'i bdag nyid rtsa gsum kun gyi spyi gzugs su bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ bdag gi lus longs spyod dus gsum dge tshogs dang bcas pa/ snod bcud rten dang brten par bcas pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi tshul du 'bul ba'i mos pas maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ sa gzhi spos sogs/ slar yang khyed rang rnams kyi sku lus rnam smin gyi phung po 'di nyid kyi dbu'i ya thod hag gis bkog pa'i nang du sku lus lhag ma ril por bcug pa la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi ro brgya dang ldan pa dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can du mer gyis zhu ba bla ma'i ljags rdo rje'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus drangs te gsol ba'i mos pa dang bcas te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan pas yid 'phrog pa// legs sbyar 'di ni dpal ldan bla ma la// dad pas phul bas 'gro ba 'di dag kun// 'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru ga ṇa tsakra sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ.i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ de nas lus zhing rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam par sprul te bla ma'i zhabs la spyi bos gtugs te phyag 'tshal ba'i mos pas thal mo sbyar te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// de ltar phyag bgyis te dad mos kyi gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba btab pa'i rkyen gyis/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen pos rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams te spyi bo nas mngon par dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/

ces dngos su bum pa spyi bor bzhag dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// sogs/ sbyin par bya/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// sogs/ sngags dang bcas pas dbang bskur/ bum chu sbyin/ de ltar dbang bskur bas chu rgyun gyis lus thams cad gang*/ lus kyi dri ma dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ lam bskyed rim sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul sku thob pa'i nus pa khyad par can bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang bla ma rdo rje 'chang rang snang gi yum rdo rje snyems ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i dga' ba'i sgra dang thugs ka'i 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams spyan drangs zhal du zhugs rjes su chags pas zhu/ dkar dmar byang sems bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du mkha' gsang las babs/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang ro gcig pa de lce steng du myong bas gsang ba'i dbang bskur thob pa'i 'dun pa mdzod cig ces thod par gnas pa'i nang mchod khyor ba g.yon par sbyin la/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar// de bzhin byang chub sems rgyun gyis// de ring khyod la dbang bskur ro// oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod/ slob mas kyang*/ a ho ma hā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod cing myang*/ de ltar byang sems mgrin pa'i lam brgyud rtsa gnas thams cad du son cing khyab pas bde ba chen po'i ye shes skyes pa'i mos pa dang*/ ngag gi dri ma dag gsang ba'i dbang thob/ lam rang lus thabs ldan sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu gsung rdo rje longs sku 'grub pa'i nus pa khyad par can bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang bla ma'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi rig ma gzugs dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa zhig byung nas/ khyed rang rnams la phyag rgya'i dngos grub kyi don du gtad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni// sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma// khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che// khyer la mchod pa rtag tu gyis// zhes rig ma'i gzugs gtad/

khyed rang rnams rdo rje 'chang chen por gsal ba la/ da lta gtad pa'i rig ma de nyid yum rdo rje snyems ma'i ngo bor gnas pa/ mkha' gsang byin gyis brlab pa la sogs pa 'du shes gsum gyi sgo nas rjes su chags pa'i sbyor bas snyoms par zhugs pas byang sems gnas bzhir babs pa ste yas babs dang*/ ldog pa'i rim pas mas brtan gyi dga' bzhi nyams su myong bas rang rig bde stong brjod bral la mnyam par bzhag des shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag lam gzhan lus shes rab pho nya'i lam sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu thugs rdo rje chos kyi sku 'grub pa'i nus pa khyad par can bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar dbang gsum pa'i skabs su nyams su myong ba'i dpe'i ye shes de nyid/ don gyi gnas lugs rig pa rang bzhin gyi ngo bo 'dus ma byas pa 'khor 'das thams cad kyi srog tu gnas pa de rang ngo tshul bzhin shes pas/ glo bur bag chags kyi dri ma sangs te/ bral 'bras mngon du byas pa ste/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi sku rang rig gcer mthong du ngo sprad pa'i mos pas/ lus gnad lta stangs/ sems dus gsum rnam rtog spro bsdus ma bslad par rang rig bde stong ma bcos pa'i ngang du mnyam par 'jog pa zhu/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu// rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid// khyod kyi pha ni khyod nyid do// des sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag dbang bzhi pa thob/ lam phyag rgya chen po sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ye shes rdo rje ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i nus pa khyad par can bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ mthar slar yang mos gdung drag po mdzad pa'i rkyen gyis/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po de nyid dgyes zhing brtse ba'i nyams kyis bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin 'od kyi phung por zhu/ khyed rang rnams kyi dbu gtsug nas sib kyis thim pas bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med rtsa bral lhun grub chen po'i ngang du bzhag ste/

bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rol mos byin dbab cing*/ dkyil 'khor bsdu/ des ni 'jug sgo'i spyi dbang gi rim pa legs par grub pa yin/ grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i byin rlabs rnams rim par 'bul ba la/ thog mar do ha rnam thar gyi spyi 'grel la snyan gtod par zhu/ zhes spyi bshad kyi glegs bam yod na bsgrag 'on kyang spyi 'grel gyi dpe ma tshang na ma byas kyang rung*/ de ltar na/ thog mar grub thob lū yi pa'i byin rlabs zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu zhes brjod/ de nas byin rlabs kyi sngon du grub thob so so'i rtogs brjod lung klog pa phyag bzhes su mchis pas thog mar grub chen lū yi pa'i rnam thar la snyan gtod 'tshal/ ces brjod pa'i mthar/ gu ru lū yi pa'i lo rgyus ni/ zhes sogs lū yi pa'i rnam thar rdzogs par bklags rjes/ de lta bu'i grub thob chen po lū yi pa'i byin rlabs sgrub par byed pa la thugs mos 'di bzhin du mdzod/ de yang snang gzhi mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal 'di nyid dag pa ye shes kyi zhing khams rgya khyon tshad med pa phyi rol srung ba'i 'khor lo gzhom du med pas yongs su bskor ba'i snying por/ dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal med khang bkod pas khyad par 'phags pa lha rdzas kyi nyer spyod mtha' klas pas brgyan pa'i dbus su ri dwags kṛṣ+ṇa sā ra'i pags pa'i gdan la/ grub pa'i slob dpon chen po lū yi pa rgya gar gyi ā tsār+ya nus ldan gyi cha byad sku mdog sngo skya cung zad skem pa'i tshul can/ ral pa'i thor tshugs cung zad dang bcas shing ras kyis smad dkris gsol ba/ sku'i mdun phyogs su nya'i rgyu lto spungs pa las phyag gi blangs te gsol ba'i tshul can zhabs phyed skyil gyis bzhugs pa/ lhan cig skyes pa mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi gzi 'od phyogs brgyar 'bar bas sku bkrag mdangs dang ldan cing bzod par dka' ba'i zil can nyi ma'i snying po lta bu/

gsung gsang sngags theg pa chen po'i chos kyi rang sgra sgrog pa/ thugs zab gsal gnyis su med pa phyag rgya chen po bde stong zung 'jug chen por rtag tu mnyam par bzhag bzhin pa/ mdzad pa phrin las ma nges cir yang ston pa dpag par dka' ba'i sgyu 'phrul can/ snang srid dbang du sdud cing srid gsum zil gyi gnon pa/ lha dang lha mo dpag tu med pas mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod pa'i sku can du gsal ba'i spyan sngar khyed rang rnams kyi sku lus rnam smin gyi phung po 'di nyid kyi dbu'i ya thod hag gis bkog pa'i nang du sogs/ tshogs 'bul ba sngar bzhin la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru lū yi pa ga ṇa tsakra sogs nas/ pra yats+tsha/ de nas lus zhing rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam par sprul te sogs gong bzhin la/ bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// lū yi pa la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bsgyur/ de ltar dad mos gdung shugs drag pos phyag 'tshal zhing gsol ba 'debs par mdzad pa'i rkyen gyis/ bla ma grub thob rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po'i dpral ba nas sku'i byin rlabs kyi rang bzhin g.yon rkyang ma dang rjes su 'brel ba'i kun+da byang sems dkar po'i rgyun byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar thim/ lus kyi dri ma dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ mgrin pa nas gsung gi byin rlabs kyi ngo bo g.yas ro ma dang rjes su 'brel ba'i rak+ta byang sems dmar po'i rgyun byung ba khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim/ ngag gi dri ma dag gsang ba'i dbang thob/ smin mtshams nas thugs kyi byin rlabs dbu ma dang rjes su 'brel ba'i khu khrag 'dres pa'i byang sems byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi smin mtshams su thim/ yid kyi dri ma dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob par mos mdzod/ de dag gi ni 'dra bas 'dra ba lam du byed pa gong ma'i brda dbang rnam gsum yin/ da bzhi pa ye shes rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba la/ khyed rang rnams lus gnad lta stangs g.yo ba med pa'i ngang nas sems dus gsum rnam rtog gi spros pas ma bslad par/

rang rig bde stong brjod bral gyi ngang la yud cig mnyam par 'jog pa zhu/ de la gnas lugs kyi don ngo sprod pa'i tshul du bla ma grub thob chen po lū yi pa'i zhal nas rang gi rtogs pa brjod pa do ha rdo rje'i glus 'di ltar du gdams byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ khyi rgod mi bsrun sna la sbrang rtsi bkus pas phyogs rnams kun tu za bar byed// de bzhin blo dman skal med dag la bla ma'i gdams ngag byin pas rang rgyud sreg /skal bzang skye med rtogs pa dag cing snang ba thugs phrad tsam gyis rnam rtog 'joms// dper na glang chen rab brtan myos pa'i sna la ral gri btags pas dgra dpung 'joms// zhes do ha rtsa 'grel nang bzhin bklags pa'i mthar/ de ltar gsungs par mos mdzod/ slar yang mos gdung drag po'i rkyen gyis/ bla ma rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug lū yi pa de nyid kyi sku 'od phung gi rnam par ltem gyis zhu nas khyed rang la sib kyis thim pas sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad phus btab pa bzhin du thugs rgyud la 'phos pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces maṇ+ḍal rdul tshon nam tshom bu sogs mgo bor 'jog cing dril bu gsil/ ngag tu/ spyir 'phags yul gyi grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhis byin gyis rlobs shig khyad par rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po lū yi pas rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la byin gyis rlobs shig lus la rdo rje sku'i sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig ngag la rdo rje gsung gi sgo nas= yid la rdo rje thugs kyi sgo nas byin= yon tan mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i sgo nas= phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas= gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgo nas= da lta nyid du byin= myur ba nyid du byin= stan thog 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ des grub chen lū yi pa'i byin rlabs grub pa lags/ zhes brjod/ des rigs 'gre bas/

spyi'i bya tshul de kho na bzhin la/ lū yi pa zhes pa'i gnas su/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar gyi grub thob so so'i mtshan dang*/ rnam thar/ sku'i bkod pa/ do ha sogs rang rang gang babs bsgyur kha shes par bya ste// ༈ /gnyis pa grub chen lī la pa'i byin rlabs zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul du bcug nas/ de'i rnam thar la snyan gtod 'tshal/ zhes de'i rnam thar bklag de lta bu'i grub chen lī la pa'i byin rlabs sgrub par byed pa la/ de yang snang gzhi mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal sogs gong bzhin la/ brgyan pa'i dbus su/ rin po che'i khri stan bzang zhing bkod legs rgyal po'i 'byor pa chen pos khyad par du brgyan par byas pa'i steng du/ grub pa'i slob dpon lī la pa 'phags yul mi bdag gi cha byad dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i dbu rgyan mgul rgyan thams cad kyis spras pa/ sras dang btsun mo blon po la sogs pa 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs gzhan sngar bzhin/ do ha ni/ tshad med bzhi yi dgon pa ru// rnal 'byor rgyal po seng ge bzhin// mgo la g.yu mdog ral lngas brgyan// rnal 'byor dbang rtags rigs lnga 'chang*// seng ge'i sder mo bcu dag gis// glang po la sogs sha rus 'byed// rnal 'byor pha rol phyin bcu yis// rnam rtog mi mthun phyogs rnams 'byed// lī las de ltar rtogs pas grol// ces sogs rtsa 'grel bklags pa'am 'grel pa rjes su lung bklags pa'i dbang du byas nas rtsa ba'i tshigs bcad kho na brjod kyang rung ngo*// mthar de ltar gsungs pa'i mos pa mdzod sogs gzhan gong bzhin no// //gsum pa mthu stobs dbang phyug bi rū pa ni/ mngon rtogs skabs/ brgyan pa'i dbus su kṛṣ+ṇa sā ra'i pags pa'i stan la rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po bir+wa pa'am bi rū pa sku mdog smug nag sbom zhing thung la gsus khyim che ba/

dbu skra co bregs la me tog gi phreng bas brgyan pa/ spyan lta stangs phur tshugs su gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas sdigs mdzub nam mkhar gdengs pa/ phyag g.yon ba men gyi rwa zhal bdud rtsis gang ba/ sha na'i gos kyi 'doms dkris gru gsum can zhabs rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing*/ g.yon gyi phyogs nas mkha' 'gro zhing gi rnal 'byor ma mi mo'i tshul can gyis bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin pas mchod pa/ lhan cig skyes pa mi 'gyur ba'i sogs gong bzhin/ do ha ni/ phyag rgya chen po'i ngang nas lhan cig skyes pa de// mi bsam mi reg bdag med rang gi ngang la bzhag /chad par mi 'gyur nyams su myong ba rang gis rig /rtag par mi 'gyur mngon zhen med pas zung du 'jug/ //bzhi pa ḍom+bhi he ru ka ni/ mtha' klas pas brgyan pa'i dbus su/ grub pa'i slob dpon chen po ḍom+bhi he ru ka sku mdog dkar dmar rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ sbrul reg pa'i dug can gyis rgyan du mdzad cing*/ mthong ba'i dug can lcag gi tshul du bsnams pa/ kha rlangs kyi dug can bdun gyis dbu'i steng du gdengs kar byas shing*/ stag mo 'jigs su rung bar chibs shing*/ sku'i brla g.yon pa'i steng nas gsang ba'i yum g.yung mo rnal 'byor ma mdzes shing blta bas mi ngoms pa pad+ma can gyi mtshan nyid ldan pas 'khyud cing bde ba mchog la dgyes rgur rol pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs gong bzhin no// do ha ni/ gser 'gyur rtsi yi nus pa yis// lcags rnams gser du 'gyur ba ltar// rin chen dbang gi nus pa yis// nyon mongs gnyis med ye shes bsgyur// ces so// //lnga pa dpal shā wa ri pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su kṛṣ+ṇa sā ra'i pags pa'i stan la/ grub pa'i dbang phyug shā wa ri pa sku mdog nag po/ spyan 'bru tshugs su gzigs shing*/ phyag g.yas na mda' dang*/ g.yon na 'od ma'i gzhu bsnams pa/ gzhu mchog la phag pa'i khog stod dang khog smad bkal ba/

rma bya'i sgro mdongs gshibs pa'i smad g.yogs gsol ba/ me tog dang 'bras bu'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ sku'i g.yas g.yon na rig ma rgyan dang cha lugs gtso bo dang mtshungs pa mda' dong thogs pa gnyis kyis bsten pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs/ do ha ni/ ma rig pa yi nags tshal du// gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi ri dwags rgyu// thabs shes gnyis kyi gzhu bdungs nas// snying po don gyi mda' gcig 'phangs// 'chi ni rnam par rtog pa 'chi// sha ni gnyis su med par zos// ro ni bde ba chen por myong*// 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po thob// ces so// //drug pa dpal sa ra ha pa ni/ gong gi mtha' klas pas brgyan pa'i dbus su kṛṣ+ṇa sā ra'i pags pa'i gdan la/ grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po dpal sa ra ha'am mda' bsnun zhabs sku mdog dkar dmar dbu skra co bregs/ tshangs sku can/ ras dmar po'i aṅga rag gsol ba/ phyag gnyis kyis mda' srong ba'i tshul gyis lhan skyes de kho na nyid kyi ye shes ma nor brang thad du ston pa'i brda mtshon zhing*/ sku'i g.yon phyogs nas zhing gi rnal 'byor ma mda' mkhan mo'i tshul gyis bsten pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs so// do ha ni/ kye ho/ grogs dag lhan cig skyes pa de// gzhan nas mi rnyed bla ma dam pa'i zhal nas rnyed// don dam zhal gyi ngo bo de rtogs na// yid la 'chi ba med cing lus la chad pa med// ces so// //bdun pa kaṅka li pa ni/ bskor ba'i snying por dur khrod chen po'i sa gzhi 'jigs su rung bar/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug kaṅka li pa/ sku mdog sngo sangs dbu skra co bregs/ phyag mnyam bzhag gis bzhugs zhing rgyan med pa/ mdun na bud med kyi ro sha med pa'i keng rus nyal stabs su gnas pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs so// do ha ni/ ji ltar nam mkha' stong pa la// gcig dang gzhan gnyis spangs pa'i gzugs// rang snang ye shes btsun mo de// dpe med tha snyad kun las 'das// zhes so//

//brgyad pa grub chen mī na pa ni/ de yang snang gzhi nas/ mtha' klas pas brgyan pa'i dbus su/ grub chen mī na pa chen po sku mdog sngo sangs gcer bu rgyan spangs shing dbu skra 'dzings pa/ phyag gnyis gar bsgyur ba'i tshul mī na ste nya chen po'i khog pa bshags pa'i dbus na 'thon pa'i tshul gyis zhabs gnyis gar stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs gong 'dra/ do ha ni/ lcags kyu thogs pa'i nya pa ni// las dbang rgya mtsho'i nang du khyer// nya chen lus la brten byas nas// lha chen gdams ngag nyams blangs pas// yon tan sa dang rdo dag gis// ma theg mī na pa zhes grags// zhes so// //dgu pa grub pa'i dbang phyug go rak+ṣa'am go rak+ṣa nā tha ni/ gong bzhin gyi brgyan pa'i dbus su/ grub pa'i slob dpon chen po shrī gau rak+ṣa nā tha sku sha dkar ba/ spyan lta stangs can/ snyan la mu dra nag po dang*/ mgul du ra dung btags pa/ sku lus gcer bu'am tsakra kan+ta 'khor lo lta bu'i bem po gsol ba/ sgom shing la kos ko bsten pa'i tshul gyis skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ sku'i nye skor du ba glang gi khyu'i tshogs chen pos bskor ba/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs gong bzhin no// do ha ni/ rigs ni mchog dang 'bring dang tha ma ru// gnas pa'i rgyu la rkyen gyi stobs ldan pas// 'gag med las dbang 'bras bu ngo mtshar che// tsau raṃ gi la byang sems bsnyen bkur byas// de rkyen stobs kyis khams kyi sa bon btab// a tsin+ta yis 'chi med bdud rtsi bstan// gau rak+ṣa yis gnyis med de nyid mthong*// srid gsum ba rdzi'i rgyal po ngo mtshar che// zhes so// //bcu pa tsau raṅgi pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su zhes pa'i mtshams/ shing ljon pa la sku rgyab brten pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po tsau raṅgi pa dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs chung ngu dang ldan zhing*/ sku sha sngo sangs kyi smad dkris can/

phyag mnyam bzhag zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ lhan cig sogs/ do ha ni/ thog med srid pa yun ring du// ma rig sdong po'i rtsa ba la// 'du byed chu yis legs brlan nas// srid pa'i yan lag sna tshogs rgyas// ma rig pa yi shing chen de// bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag dang*// shes rab gsum gyi ste'u yis// tsau raṅgi yis de ring bcad// ces so// //bcu gcig pa wī na pa ni/ mtha' klas pas brgyan pa'i dbus su/ rin po che'i khri stan la grub pa'i slob dpon wī na pa sku mdog dkar dmar dar zab kyi na bza' dang thod bcings pa rgyal po'i cha byad/ rin po che'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis dzan+tar dur bar grags pa ku ba gsum pa'i rgyud mangs brdung ba'i sgra la thugs rtse gcig tu gzhol ba'i tshul can/ lhan cig skyes pa mi 'gyur ba'i sogs so// do ha ni/ phyin ci log la goms pa'i sgra// gus dang brtson pas bcad byas nas// ma grol skye med sgra bcad pas// wī na pa yis bdag med rtogs// zhes so// //bcu gnyis pa grub chen shān+ti pa ni/ de yang snang gzhi mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal 'di nyid dag pa ye shes kyi zhing khams rgya khyon tshad med pa/ dkon mchog gtsug lag khang bkod pas khyad par 'phags pa'i nang*/ lha rdzas kyi nyer spyod mtha' klas pas brgyan pa'i dbus su rin po che'i khri dang gding ba'i stan la slob dpon chen po rat+na ā ka ra shān+ti pa sku mdog dkar sngo cung zad bgres pa'i rnam pa can/ chos gos rnam pa gsum dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta'i cod pan gsol ba/ phyag g.yas bshad pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon glegs bam bsnams pa/ zab dang rgya che'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshul can/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs/ do ha ni/ bu chung ma yis gsos pa yis// gyad kyi stobs dang ldan pa bzhin// blo chung bla ma'i man ngag gis// rim gyis khrid pas theg pa che// rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa yi// nad rnams sman gyis sel ba ltar// nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa ni// bla ma'i gdams pas skad cig sreg

/ces pa'o// //bcu gsum pa grub chen tan+t+ri pa ni/ dbus su grub chen tan+t+ri pa sku sngo sangs shin tu smin pa'i na tshod can/ ag tshom dang*/ sma ra ring du 'phyang ba dbu skyes thams cad kun+da ltar dkar ba ras kyi smad dkris gsol zhing khri thags kyi bya ba la brtson pa'i tshul du chos kyi nges gnas brda thabs kyis ston pa/ lhan cig sogs/ do ha ni/ 'jig rten pa yi thags mkhan rnams// snal ma thams cad thags su btags// nga ni bla ma'i gdams ngag gis// chos rnams thams cad thags su 'thag /stong nyid gnas su ye shes lnga'i// snal ma man ngag btag so dang*// shes rab kyi ni sgrom bu yis// dbyings rig gnyis med chos skur btags// zhes so// //bcu bzhi pa tsa ma ri ba la/ brgyan pa'i dbus su/ zhes pa'i mtshams/ grub pa'i dbang phyug tsa ma ri pa sku mdog sngo sangs ras kyi smad dkris can/ phyag gnyis l+h+wam bzo'i bya ba mdzad pas kun rdzob brdas gnyug ma sems kyi don mtshon pa/ zhabs gnyis ci bder bzhugs pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs 'dra'o// do ha ni/ rnam rtog mtshan ma'i ko ba 'di// stong nyid snying rje'i spangs su bcug /chos brgyad spangs pa'i rgyun gyis ni// shes rab nyams myong snyungs bus btsems// lhun grub chos sku'i l+h+wam byed pa// tsa ma ri pa l+h+wam mkhan mchog /ces so// //bco lnga pa grub thob khaḍ+ga pa la/ dbus su grub pa'i slob dpon khaḍ+ga pa sku mdog sngo sangs ras kyi ang rag gsol ba/ phyag g.yas grub pa'i ral gri ye shes kyi me 'bar ba bsnams te nam mkhar 'phur ba'i tshul/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs/ do ha ni/ mtshon cha med pa'i dpa' bo ni// rgyun du dgra dang g.yul 'gyed kyang*// bdag nyid sdug bsngal dbang du 'gyur// 'chi med ye shes ral gri yis// srid gsum dgra rnams pham byas nas// khaḍ+ga pa yis longs spyod byed// ces so// //bcu drug pa mgon po klu sgrub ni/

mtha' klas pas brgyan pa'i dbus su rin po che'i khri stan la/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub sku mdog sngo sangs nor bu rin po che'i mdog ltar dwangs shing dri ma med pa shin tu mtshar ba/ mtshan dpes spras shing*/ phyag gnyis chos 'khor gyi phyag rgya thugs kar mdzad pa/ na bza' chos gos rnam gsum gsol zhing rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ klu'i rgyal po mchog rnams sbrul gyi rnam pas mchod cing bsnyen bkur ba'i phyir gdengs ka'i grib ma 'bul ba la sku rgyab brten pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs so// do ha ni/ gang zhig ma rtogs spyod pa mi bya ste// byas na rgyal srid 'bangs kyis bzung ba bzhin// rtogs pas ma rtogs spyod pa mi bya ste// byas na glang chen 'dam du byings pa 'dra// zhes so// //bcu bdun pa slob dpon chen po kah+ṇa pa'am nag po spyod pa ni/ mtha' klas pas brgyan pa'i dbus su/ grub pa'i slob dpon chen po brtul zhugs spyod pa nag po'i zhabs sku mdog nag po/ phyag g.yas cang te'u 'khrol zhing*/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ mchan khung du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug dang stag sham gsol ba/ bi shwa rū bi nī zhes pa'i srin mo'i gtso mo 'jigs su rung ba'i gzugs gdan nam bzhon pa'i tshul du gnas pa'i steng na phyed skyil gyis bzhugs pa/ res 'ga' ro langs chen po me tog gi phreng bas brgyan pa la chibs pa sogs sna tshogs rdzu 'phrul rol pa ston pa/ steng gi nam mkhar gdugs bdun 'dzin pa med par 'khor zhing*/ ḍa ma ru bdun 'khrol ba med par sgra grags bzhin pa/ res 'ga' gdugs bdun brgyad dang ḍa ma ru bdun brgyar 'phel ba'i cho 'phrul can/ snang ba dang mi snang ba'i 'khor grub pa dang rig 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor pho mo dpag tu med pa'i 'khor lo'i 'du bar rtag tu spyod pa/ lhan cig skyes pa mi 'gyur ba sogs 'dra/

do ha ni/ shing rta 'khor lo bzhi dang mi ldan khrid kyang 'gro bar mi nus ltar// sbyin sogs 'bad pa byas kyang bla ma mi ldan dngos grub dam pa min// bya rgod rtsal rdzogs 'dab gshog rgyas pa dag ni nam mkhar spyod cing rgyu// skal bzang rnal 'byor rnams ni dbang gi gdams ngag khong du chud pas bde// zhes so// //bco brgyad pa kar+ṇa ra pa'am ār+ya de wa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su dge slong gi yo byad gding ba'i stan la slob dpon chen po 'phags pa lha sku mdog sngo sangs dge slong gi cha byad chos gos rnam pa gsum dang ldan shing*/ zhabs skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ kar+ṇa ri zhes pa'i shing chen po phyag na bsnams pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs so// do ha ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad ngo bo gcig /de ni rtogs na rang bzhin rang gi sems// rtogs par 'dod na ma bcos ji bzhin zhog /goms par byas na rnal 'byor mngon du 'gyur// ces so// //bcu dgu pa grub chen tha ga na pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su pags pa'i gdan la grub pa'i slob dpon tha ga na sku mi sha kha sngo sangs shing ljon pa la sku rgyab brten pa'i phyed snyes kyis bzhugs shing phyag sa gnon sogs ci bder spyod pa/ lhan cig sogs/ do ha ni/ gang zhig rna bar chu zhugs pa// chu nyid kyis ni 'byin pa bzhin// de bzhin snang srid brdzun pa la// brdzun par bsgoms pas bden pa mthong*// zhes so// //nyi shu pa dpal nā ro pa ni/ de yang snang gzhi zhes nas/ mtha' klas pas brgyan pa'i dbus su kṛṣ+ṇa sā ra'i pags pa'i gdan la/ grub pa'i slob dpon chen po dpal nā ro pa sku mdog smug nag gzi byin mtshungs pa med pa'i zil dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug sogs kyis spras pa/ dar gyi aṅga rag gsol ba'am stag lpags kyi smad dkris can/ mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs mdzad pa'i rkang lag gnyis phyag gis bzung ste phan tshun du brgyangs pa'am phyag g.yas kyis mi lpags brgyangs shing*/

g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ zhabs gar stabs sam/ brkyangs bskum gyi tshul du bzhugs shing*/ mdun du gsang yum mkha' 'gro ma mi mo'i rnam pa mtshar sdug phun sum tshogs pas bdud rtsi 'bul ba/ lhan cig skyes pa mi 'gyur pa'i sogs/ do ha ni/ 'khor los sgyur rgyal dpung tshogs rnams kyis ni// gling dang gling phran rnams la dbang byed ltar// lhan cig skyes pa'i ro rnyed rnal 'byor ni// 'khor ba dbang bsgyur bde ba chen po yin// ces so// //nyer gcig pa grub chen sh+yā li pa ni/ dur khrod kyi sa gzhi 'jigs su rung bar pags pa'i stan la grub chen sh+yā li pa sku sngo sangs ras kyi ang rag gsol ba/ lce spyang gi ro phrag par bkal ba/ lhan cig sogs so// do ha ni/ legs sbyar ri mo mkhan dag gis// shin tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs brnyan bris// mthong na bdag nyid 'jigs gyur la// brtags na ma grub gzugs brnyan snang*// zhes so// //nyer gnyis pa grub chen til+li pa ni/ mtha' klas pas brgyan pa'i dbus su/ grub pa'i slob dpon chen po til+li pa sku sha sngo nag dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ ras kyi ang rag gsol zhing til rdung ba'i rnam pa can/ mdun du rig ma zhing gi rnal 'byor ma til mkhan ma'i rnam pas til lugs pa'i bya ba la brtson pas/ gnyug ma'i ye shes rang la rang chas su bzhugs pa ngo sprod pa'i brda mtshon pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs so// do ha ni/ ri rab ngos la bya gnas pa// bya yi rang bzhin gser du snang*// mkhas pa skye med rtogs pa yis// dngos po bor nas bde ba che// zhes so// //nyer gsum pa tsa tra pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su pags pa'i gdan la/ grub chen tsa tra pa sku mdog dkar dmar rab byung gi cha byad/ glegs bam gyi khur bu rgyab tu bsnams shing*/ phyag tu glegs bam chung ngu 'dzin pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs/ do ha ni/ rnal 'byor pa yis gang mthong gdams pa yin// mthong ba skye med rtogs pa slob dpon mchog

/byis pa rnams kyis gnyis 'dzin rtog pa yis// dge sdig 'bras bu de la gnyis mi 'byung*// zhes so// //nyer bzhi pa gu ru bha dra pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su kṛṣ+ṇa sā ra'i pags pa'i gdan la/ grub pa'i slob dpon bha dra pa sku sha dkar dmar lang tsho rgyas pa'i nyams ldan/ dbu skra shad pa bcings pa'i thor cog can/ tshangs skud dang*/ rna rgyan sogs rin po che'i rgyan thor bus spras pa/ phyag mnyam par bzhag pa'i phyag rgya dang zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ sku'i mdun ngos su phag gi sha dang myos byed kyi bum pa bcas yod pa/ de'i g.yas phyogs brag steng mtho ba na bla ma rnal 'byor pa ral pa'i thor tshugs can mnyam gzhag la bzhugs pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs/ do ha ni/ stong nyid rtogs pas 'khrul pa dag /byams pa bsgoms pas spyod pa rdzogs// sna tshogs gnyis med bsgoms pa yis// gzhi mthun ro gcig 'bras bu yin// ces so// //nyer lnga pa dhū khan+dhi pa ni/ pags pa'i gdan la grub pa'i dbang phyug dhū khan+dhi pa sku mdog sngo sangs dbu skra co bregs/ phyag dur khrod kyi gos hrul pa sna tshogs gcig tu bsdus te 'drub pa'i tshul gyis/ chos can thams cad chos nyid gcig tu 'du ba'i brda ston pa/ zhabs g.yas mdun du brkyangs zhing*/ g.yon phyed krung gis bzhugs pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs/ do ha ni/ kun rdzob bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*// don dam rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis// zung 'jug phyag rgya chen por bsgoms// 'bras bu sku gsum ye shes 'char// ces so// //nyer drug pa a dzo gi pa ste sbyor bral zhes pa'i slob dpon ni/ dur khrod kyi sa gzhi mi mgo skam rnying rlon pas gang ba'i gzhi la/ grub pa'i slob dpon a dzo gi pa sku mdog sngo skya ral pa'i thor tshugs cung zad dang bcas pa 'phred nyal stabs kyis gzims pa'i tshul can/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs/ do ha ni/

bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gis// steng sgo sna rtser thig le bsgoms// de nyid la ni blo brtan pas// yungs kar stong gsum dmigs pa stor// ces so// //nyer bdun pa grub chen ka la pa ni/ mtha' klas pas brgyan pa'i dbus su/ grub thob chen po ka la pa sku mdog dkar dmar mdzes zhing blta bas mi ngoms pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs chung ngu can/ phyag mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya dang*/ zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs/ do ha ni/ 'gro ba 'di dag thog med dus nas 'khrul// de yis 'jig rten thams cad smyon par grags// bla ma'i gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i sman gyis ni// 'khrul pa'i nad rnams skad cig gcig la sreg /ces so// //nyer brgyad pa grub chen dhū bi pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su pags pa'i gdan la grub pa'i dbang phyug dhū bi ra dza sku mdog sngo sangs ras kyi smad dkris gsol zhing zhabs pus btsugs/ mdun du chu rgyun la gos rnying pa sna tshogs pa 'khrud pa'i tshul gyis sems kyi dri ma sbyong ba'i brda ston pa/ g.yon du rig mas bsten pa/ lhan cig sogs/ do ha ni/ yun ring dus nas dri ma 'khrud byas kyang*// sol ba'i rang bzhin dkar por 'gyur ba med// rang bzhin rnam dag stong nyid gos dag la// bla ma'i gdams pa rang bzhin khrus mkhan mchog /ces so// //nyer dgu pa grub chen kaṅka na pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su rin po che'i khri bkod legs dang dar zab kyi 'bol stan la/ grub thob chen po kaṅka na sku mdog dkar dmar mdangs ldan rgyal po'i cha byad dar dang rin po ches spras pa/ phyag g.yas pa'i gdu bu nor bu rin po che 'od 'bar ba la rtse gcig tu gzigs pa'i tshul can zhabs rol stabs su bzhugs pa/ mtha' bskor btsun mo blon 'bangs kyis bskor zhing*/ steng gi bar snang gi nam mkha' nas lha dang lha mo'i tshogs kyis mchod pa 'bul ba/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs/

do ha ni/ rtogs pa yid bzhin nor bu la// nyams su myong ba'i mdog 'byung bas// spyod pa nus pas dgos 'dod 'byung*// ro snyoms ldan pa rnams kyis 'grub// ces so// //sum cu pa grub thob kam+pa la pa ste slob dpon lwa wa pa ni/ de yang sogs nas/ nyer spyod mtha' klas pas brgyan pa'i dbus su/ kṛṣ+ṇa sā ra'i pags pa'i gdan la grub pa'i slob dpon chen po kam+pa la/ sku mdog dkar dmar dge slong gi cha byad/ sku la lwa ba'i na bza' gsol zhing*/ phyag mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgyas ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jog bzhin pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs so// do ha ni/ rgya mtsho zab cing rgya che'i nang na nor bus gang ba la// klu yi rgyal po rnams ni de la longs spyod ngo mtshar che// de bzhin snang grags thams cad ye nas chos sku yin pa la// rtogs pa dang ldan rnams ni de la longs spyod ngo mtshar che// zhes so// //so gcig pa grub chen ḍiṅgi pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su kṛṣ+ṇa sā ra'i pags pa'i gdan la slob dpon chen po ḍiṅgi pa sku la ras kyi smad dkris gsol zhing ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ phyag gnyis snod du 'bras blugs te gtun shing gis 'bras sbru zhing chu la 'khrud pas snying po'i don gyi brda ston pa/ zhabs pus btsugs kyi rnam pa/ sku yi gam nas rig ma bzang mos chu yi rgyun lugs pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs/ do ha ni/ rta dang glang po rgya mtsho 'dra na rab tu bde// spre'u byis pa chu yi ri mo 'dra na rtogs pa yin// chu bo nyi ma sman dang 'dra na dbyer mi phyed// gtsug phud mig dang 'khor lo lta bus 'bras bu thob// ces so// //so gnyis pa grub chen ban+dhe pa ni/ mtha' klas pas brgyan pa'i dbus su/ rin po che'i khri stan dar zab kyi 'bol dang bcas pa'i steng du slob dpon ban+dhe pa rgyal po'i cha byad sku dkar dmar mdangs ldan/ dar gyi 'dud ma dang thod bcings/

rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras pa/ phyed krung ngam rol stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ lhan cig sogs/ do ha ni/ mngon zhen med pa byams pa'i mchog /gnas lugs rtogs pa snying rje yin// zag med bde ba dga' ba ste// gzhi mthun ro gcig btang snyoms rdzogs// zhes so// //so gsum pa tan+te pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su/ grub pa'i dbang phyug tan+te pa sku sngo sangs rgya gar pa phal pa'i cha byad ras kyi smad dkris dang thod bcings pa/ phyag gnyis rgya gar gyi lugs dang mthun pa'i sho bsnams te sho gdan gyi steng du rol rtsed mdzad pa'i tshul can/ lhan cig sogs/ do ha ni/ ji ltar dran rig sna tshogs dag /rtog med dbyings su zad cing 'gag /de bzhin snang srid chos rnams kun// stong nyid dbyings su zad cing 'gag /ces so// //so bzhi pa grub chen ku ku ri pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su kṛṣ+ṇa sā ra'i pags pa'i gdan la grub pa'i slob dpon chen po ku ku ri pa/ sku mdog mi sha kha sngo mdangs cung zad yod pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis mdzes pa ras kyi smad dkris can/ phyag g.yon ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin cing*/ sku pang du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ku ku rī gzhon nu'i gzugs can phyag g.yas kyis bzung ste dgyes rgur rol pa'i tshul/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs so// do ha ni/ sangs rgyas mchod sogs rnams la don mi 'byung*// 'dod dang 'bad rtsol yod na sangs rgyas min// byin rlabs bla ma'i zhal las nyams myong dpal// cha ldan rang la yod kyang ma mthong ngo*// zhes so// //so lnga pa ku dzi pa ni/ pags pa'i gdan la grub pa'i slob dpon ku dzi pa sku mdog sngo sangs rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad ras kyi ang rag gsol ba/ ltag pa'i phyogs su lba bas mtshan pa/ mdun na slob dpon klu sgrub bzhugs pa la gus pas bsnyen pa'i tshul can/ lhan cig sogs so// do ha ni/

bla ma'i gsung gi 'od zer gyis// yod dang med pa'i mtha' ma rnyed// gang zhig ma rnyed de mtha' 'o// mtha' de rtogs na don gyi mchog /ces so// //so drug pa dha ma pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su kṛṣ+ṇa sā ra'i pags pa'i gdan la grub chen dha ma pa sku sha dkar sngo bram ze'i cha byad gtsug phud dang*/ tshangs skud ril ba dang bcas shing*/ ras kyi smad dkris can/ phyag na glegs bam bsnams pa/ sku yi nye skor du yang po ti mang po dang bcas pa/ lhan cig sogs/ do ha ni/ gnyis 'dzin ma rig dug dag gis// rig pa'i skyes bu rgyun du bzung*// bla ma'i gsung gi byin rlabs kyis// snang srid 'khrul pa'i dug nad sel// ces so// //so bdun pa ma hi la ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su kṛṣ+ṇa sā ra'i pags pa'i gdan la grub chen ma hi la sku lus yan lag sbom zhing sha sul can/ gzhan la lus stobs 'gran pa'i tshul can/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs/ do ha ni/ ma rig nga rgyal ri bo yis// rtogs pa yid bzhin nor bu bsgribs// spyod pa nus pas dgos 'dod 'byung*// ro snyoms ldan pa rnams kyis 'grub// ces pa'o// //so brgyad pa grub chen a tsin+ta pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su nags tshal gyi phreng bar/ grub chen a tsin+ta pa ras kyi 'doms dkris gsol zhing*/ shing phung dang s+t+wa re bsnams nas shing gcod pa'i tshul gyis 'khrul pa'i drwa ba gcod pa'i brda ston pa/ lhan cig sogs/ do ha ni/ dmigs med phyag rgya chen po ru// 'khrul pa'i dran rig sna tshogs stor// ye shes rig pa'i snang ba yis// rang snang phyag rgya chen po mthong*// zhes so// //so dgu pa ba bha hi ni/ dbus su rin po che'i khri dang dar zab bzang po'i 'bol stan la/ grub pa'i slob dpon chen po ba bha hi mi bdag gi cha byad/ sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can la/ na bza' smad g.yogs las gzhan med par/ dbu rgyan phyag zhabs rin po che'i gdu bus mdzes pa/

sku yi g.yon phyogs nas mtshar sdug phun sum tshogs pa'i btsun mos 'khyud pas/ 'pho med bde chen gyi ro la dgyes pas rol pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs/ do ha ni/ dper na ngang pa'i rgyal po yis// chu las 'o ma 'byed pa bzhin// bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gis// byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi blangs// bde'o bde'o dngos med bde// zhen pa med pas dngos med bde// rtogs pa thams cad der shes bde// bsgrub bya med pas gsang ba bde// zhes so// //bzhi bcu pa grub chen nā li nā pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su pags pa'i gdan la grub pa'i dbang phyug nā li nā pa sku mdog dkar dmar bram ze cha byad/ mtsho'i dbus na me tog pad+ma'i sdong bu rtsa ba dang bcas te gcod pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs/ do ha ni/ spyi bo pad+ma 'dam skyes su// sa bon g.yo ba dga' ba ste// snying ga mgrin pa mchog tu dga'// lhan skyes dga' bral bla med thob// ces so// //zhe gcig pa slob dpon zhi ba lha ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su seng ge'i khri bzang po'i 'bol stan gding bas bkab pa'i steng du/ grub pa'i slob dpon chen po bhu su ku pa'am/ shān+ta de wa sku mdog dkar dmar sha nyams rgyas pa/ dge slong gi cha byad chos gos gsol ba/ zhabs skyil mo krung bcas te dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po'i dbus su/ 'jigs pa med pa'i tshul gyis byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa gsungs bzhin du nam mkha' la je mthor 'phags pa'i tshul can/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs/ do ha ni/ bdag gis ma rtogs bar du ro la khyad par che// de bzhin 'khor ba dag dang sangs rgyas khyad par che// rtogs pa'i dus na 'khor 'das bde ba chen po ste// dper na rgya mtsho'i nang na 'bar ba'i rin chen bzhin// zhes so// //zhe gnyis pa slob dpon in+d+ra bo dhi ni/ mtha' klas pas brgyan pa'i dbus su/ gzhal yas khang pa yid du mchis par rin po che'i khri dar zab kyi 'bol la/

gsang ba sngags kyi bdag po chen po grub pa kun gyi dbang phyug chos kyi rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs ldan mdzes pa/ 'khor los bsgyur ba chen po'i cha byad/ khams gsum dbang phyug chen po'i 'byor pas gtams shing*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mi'i bu mo'i tshul bzung ba'i btsun mo mtshar sdug phun sum tshogs pa lnga brgyas/ glu gar rol mo reg bya'i mchod pas rtag tu mchod cing 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i longs spyod dga' ston lam du khyer ba'i spros bcas kyi spyod pa chen po brtsams pa'i tshul can gyis dgyes rgur rol pa/ lhan cig skyes pa mi 'gyur ba'i sogs so// do ha ni/ dus kyi sna rtse dag ni bdag byin rlabs dang mi ldan na// phyi nang kun tu spyod pa dag gis rnal 'byor 'tshang mi rgya// dga' bde'i rang bzhin sangs rgyas dag dang khyad par med par ni// zhen pa btang na rang bzhin skyes pa'i nyams myong mchog tu 'gyur// zhes so// //zhe gsum pa slob dpon me ko pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su grub pa'i slob dpon me ko ba sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can/ khyim pa tha mal pa'i cha byad gos phu dung can dang thod bcings pa/ phyag gnyis snum khur bzo ba'i bya ba mdzad cing*/ sku'i mdun phyogs su kha zas kyi bye brag sna tshogs pa bkram pa/ rig ma mdzes mas g.yos kyi bya ba mdzad pa'i tshul can/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs so// do ha ni/ bla ma dag las dang por rang gi sems rtogs bya// de nas rnam pa kun tu tha dad med bya ste// gnyis med goms pas dur khrod gnas su 'dug par bya// mnyam par rtogs nas smyon pa'i brtul zhugs spyad par bya// zhes so// //zhe bzhi pa slob dpon tog tse pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su grub pa'i dbang phyug tog tse pa sku mdog sngo nag dbu la thod bcings shing ras kyi smad dkris can/ phyag gnyis kyis tog tse bsnams te zhing tha rengs brko ba'i tshul gyis/

rang rgyud rengs pa 'dul dgos pa'i brda mdzad pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs so// do ha ni/ bde sdug thams cad sems las byung*// gdams pas sems kyi ri bo brkos// sa yi ri bo brkos gyur kyang*// gnyug ma'i bde chen thob mi 'gyur// tha mal shes pa snying gi dbus su sad// tshogs drug dag na bde chen rgyun mi chad// brtags pa thams cad don med sdug bsngal rgyu// sgom dang mi sgom gnyug ma'i ngang du zhog /ces so// //zhe lnga pa kam+bha ri pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su grub pa'i slob dpon kam+bha ri pa sku mdog sngo nag sha na'i gos kyi smad dkris can thod bcings pa/ phyag gnyis tho ba dang skam pa bzung ste/ lcags mgar gyi las la brtson pas/ dug gsum chos kyi sku ru sbyangs pa'i brda ston pa/ lhan cig sogs/ do ha ni/ rang bzhin lus kyi sol mal du// dran rig rnam rtog sol ba la// la lā ra sā'i sbud pas bus// dhū tī ye shes me sbar nas// dug gsum rnam rtog chos skur brdungs// kaṃ bha ri pas rtogs nas grol// ces so// //zhe drug pa dza lan+dha ra pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su kṛṣ+ṇa sā ra'i pags pa'i gdan la grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po dza lan+dha ra pa'am 'bar 'dzin zhabs sku mdog dkar dmar ral pa'i thor tshugs dang rus rgyan can/ ras dmar gyi 'doms dkris gsol ba/ zhabs phyogs gcig rgyab nas dpung par bkal zhing*/ phyogs gcig bzhengs pa'i pus btsugs kyi tshul can/ phyag gnyis rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya ldog ste spyi bor 'ching ba/ g.yon gyi phyogs nas rig ma rnal 'byor ma'i cha byad kyis 'dud bzhin pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs so// do ha ni/ khams gsum lus ngag yid gsum gyi// dran rig rnam rtog sna tshogs kun// la lā ra sā dhu tī ru// bdag byin brlab phyir bcing bar bgyi// zhes so// //zhe bdun pa grub chen rā hu la pa ni/

kṛṣ+ṇa sā ra'i pags pa'i gdan la grub pa'i slob dpon rā hu la pa sku sngo sangs yid tsam bgres pa/ dbu skra co bregs phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag dang*/ zhabs gnyis skyil krung gis dur khrod kyis gzhi la bzhugs shing*/ dur khrod kyi mi ro la gzigs pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs so// do ha ni/ phyi yi sgra gcan bzang po yis// zla ba'i snang ba gnyis med zos// kun rdzob zla ba'i thig le ni// dbyings rig sgra gcan gnyis med zos// zhes so// //zhe brgyad pa dharma pa ni/ dge sbyong gi yo byad gding ba'i stan la grub pa'i dbang phyug dharma pa sku sngo sangs ches cher smin pa'i na tshod can dge sbyong gi chas ldan/ po ti phyag na bsnams shing zhabs sems skyil kyis bzhugs pa/ lhan cig sogs so// do ha ni/ snang srid chos kyi kong bu ru// byang chub sems kyi mar khu blugs// tshogs drug rnam shes sdong bu la// gnyis med ye shes me sbar bas// rnam rtog 'khrul pa'i mun pa bcom// zhes so// //zhe dgu pa dho ka ri pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su slob dpon dho ka ri pa sku mdog smug nag slong mo pa'i cha byad/ phyag gnyis dzo la zhes pa drwa ba'i snod du kha zas kyi snod chen po dbyug pa'i dpyang thag can bsnams te slong mo slong ba'i tshul du bzhengs pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs/ do ha ni/ chos dbyings rang bzhin snod dag tu// rig pa chos sku'i rdzas nyid bcug /dbyings rig gnyis med 'bras bu ni// skal ldan rnal 'byor rig pas rtogs// zhes so// //lnga bcu pa me dhi ni pa ni/ dbus su grub chen me dhi ni pa sku sngo sangs rmos mkhan gyi cha byad/ ral pa'i thor tshugs cung zad dang bcas shing*/ ras kyi smad dkris can/ rmos glang gnyis la gnya' shing btsugs te zhing rmo ba'i tshul gyis chos kyi nges gnas ston pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs/ do ha ni/ rig pa gnyug ma'i shes rab dang*// nyams myong goms pa'i thabs dag gis// rang bzhin gnas lugs gzhi dag las// bde chen lhun grub 'bras bu rtogs// zhes so//

//nga gcig pa gu ru paṅka dza pa ni/ mtha' klas pas brgyan pa'i dbus su/ slob dpon chen po paṃ ka dza pa sku mdog dkar dmar gzhon pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ bram ze'i cha byad/ zhabs gar stabs kyis bzhengs zhing pad+ma'i rdzing bu'i 'gram na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi lha khang la bsnyen bkur mdzad pa/ lhan skyes sogs/ do ha ni/ ji ltar bla mas ma zin ma rtogs dus dag tu// yid bzhin nor bu dang ni nor bu mching bu mnyam// bla ma dang ni rtogs pa yongs su zin gyur na// nyi zla'i 'od dang srin bu me khyer ji bzhin no// zhes pa'o// //nga gnyis pa badz+ra ghāṇ+ḍe pa'am rdo rje dril bu pa ni/ mtha' klas pas brgyan pa'i dbus su/ grub pa'i slob dpon chen po rdo rje dril bu pa sku mdog mi sha kha sngo sangs zhi ma khro/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam pa gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa phyag rgya lnga ldan shin tu mdzes ma la mnyam par sbyor ba'i bde bas dgyes pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum gyi stabs kyis mkha' dbyings mthon por 'phags pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs so// do ha ni/ la lā ra sā dhū tī gsum// bdag byin brlab phyir bcing bar bya// bla ma sems dang snang ba gsum// rtogs pa bskyed phyir mkhas pas bsten// ces so// //nga gsum pa dzo gi pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su grub chen dzo gi pa rnal 'byor gyi cha byad sku sngo sangs gcer bu/ 'khar ba thogs shing yo byad rnams phrag dbyug gi rtser btags shing*/ phrag khur thogs pa'i rnam pa can nam/ phyag thod pa 'dzin par byas kyang rung*/ lhan cig skyes sogs/ do ha ni/ mar me'i rtse mo lta bu yi// phra zhing gsal ba'i yid goms pas// brtan cing g.yo ba'i dngos po kun// chos kyi dbyings su rnam par thim// zhes so//

//nga bzhi pa tsa lu ki pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su pags pa'i gdan la grub pa'i slob dpon tsa lu ki pa rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad/ la ṭi zhes pa 'bol stan sngas su bcug nas gzims pa/ mdun du sgom shing ci bder bskyur ba'i tshul can/ g.yon phyogs nas rig mas brten pa/ lhan cig sogs so// do ha ni/ bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag ni// yun ring dus su bsgoms pa yis// sa sogs rim par thim pa las// rang snang phyag rgya chen por 'gyur// ces so// //nga lnga pa grub thob gu dhū ri pa ni/ dbus su grub thob gu dhū ri pa sku sngo sangs sku smad la shing lo'i gos can/ dbu skra co bregs/ snyi btsugs te bya sna tshogs pa gshor ba'i rnam pa can/ lhan cig sogs so// do ha ni/ phyi nang chos kun sems su 'dus// sems nyid gsal ba'i don rtogs na// spyod lam rnam bzhi chos kyi sku// rtogs pa mngon gyur rdzogs sangs rgyas// zhes so// //nga drug pa gu ru lu tsi ka pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su grub chen lu tsi ka pa sku mdog dkar nyams bram ze'i cha byad/ skra dang kha spu rnams 'ja' rtses 'thog ste zad pa'i rnam pa can/ lhan cig sogs/ do ha ni/ gang zhig thog ma med dus nas// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor yun ring 'khyams// bla ma dam pa'i gru dag gis// brgal dka'i mtsho las de ring thar// ces so// //nga bdun pa grub chen na gu ṇa pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su grub chen gu ṇa khyim pa'i cha byad/ sku mdog dkar la dmar mdangs can/ mal khri la rgyab snyes nas zas za ba'i tshul can/ lhan cig sogs/ do ha ni/ chu rlabs lta bu'i nyams brten nas// spyod par bags kyis 'gro bar bya// bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gis// chags sdang rtog pa rang zhir bya// zhes so// //re brgyad par dza yā nan+di pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su kṛṣ+ṇa sā ra'i pags pa'i gdan la grub pa'i slob dpon dza yā nan+di pa bram ze'i slob dpon dge bsnyen tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/

ras kyi smad dkris gsol zhing*/ phyag gis ting shag bsnams te rdung ba'i tshul gyis gtor ma sna tshogs pa gtong ba'i rnam pa can/ sku'i mdun du bya sna tshogs 'dus shing*/ 'khor slob ma skyes pa dang bud med sna tshogs rdza rnga rdung ba dang*/ gling bu 'bud pa sogs 'bud dkrol gyi bya ba byed pa la brtson pa rnams kyis bskor ba/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs/ do ha ni/ ye shes rig pa'i ting nge 'dzin// thad ka ma de gnyug mar gnas// ji ltar rtogs na nges pa yin// rnam rtog dran pa de nyid min// ces so// //nga dgu pa tsa ri pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su grub chen pa tsa ri pa rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad skra bregs pa/ shing ljon pa'i drung na bzhugs shing 'doms dkris gru gsum pa zhig ma gtogs na bza' med pa mdun du me btang ste snum khur btsos pa la/ snum khur gcig gi phyed zhal du gsol ba'i rnam pa/ mdun na spyan ras gzigs bzhengs te chos ston pa/ lhan cig sogs/ do ha ni/ gar yang ma lta dbus su ltos// mchog dang dga' bral bde ba che// sngags kyi gsang ba'i stobs spyad na// rnal 'byor rtags kyis bsdu bar bya// zhes so// drug cu pa grub chen tsam pa ka pa ni/ mtha' klas pas brgyan pa'i dbus su rin po che'i khri dang dar zab kyi 'bol stan la/ grub chen tsam pa ka pa sku mdog dkar dmar lang tsho rgyas pa/ dar gyi na bza' phu dung can dang*/ rin po ches brgyan pa/ phyag na me tog gi phreng ba bsnams pa/ mtha' skor gyi skyed tshal rnams tsam+pa ka yi shing ste/ yal ga rnams zlum por skyes pa/ lo ma ljang nag me tog ser skya yod pa/ de lta bu'i skyed tshal gyi dbus na bzhugs pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs so// do ha ni/ thabs dang shes rab 'od gsal lta bu la// bla ma chu bo'i rgyun gyis kun la khyab// lhan cig skyes pas dpag bsam shing dag la// 'bras bu sku gsum rang gsal rang la rdzogs// zhes so//

//re gcig pa grub chen bhik+ṣa ṇa pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su pags pa'i gdan la slob dpon bhik+ṣa ṇa pa sku sngo sangs/ phyag na ku ba'i snod bsnams shing*/ phyag gcig pa rang gis tshems gcig mdun mkhar ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo zhi ba rus rgyan can gyis chos ston pa la 'bul ba'i tshul can/ lhan cig sogs/ do ha ni/ bla med bgrod dka'i byang chub gnas chen du// zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i lam bstan nas// phyogs cha bral ba'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug mchog /bla ma'i gdams pa'i drin gyis de nyid rtogs// zhes so// //re gnyis pa grub chen dhi li pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su grub pa'i slob dpon bhi li pa ras kyi thod dkris dang stod g.yogs smad g.yogs can/ mdun du mar nag gi snod chen po mang du bshams te 'tshong ba'i tshul dang kha zas sna tshogs bshams pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs/ do ha ni/ bdag nyid gdod nas sangs rgyas la// rtogs pa'i dbang gi chos nyid yin// dbang blangs lhan cig skyes pa des// skye med rgyas 'debs rje bo 'dzin// ces so// //re gsum pa kum+bha ri pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su grub pa'i slob dpon kum+bha ri pa rdza mkhan gyi cha lugs 'khor lo bskor te rdza bzo ba'i tshul can/ shes rab mas mtha' brten pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs/ do ha ni/ rgyu mthun las kyi 'khor lo yis// srid pa'i zlos gar sna tshogs byas// ye shes rig pa'i me yis ni// 'khrul pa'i dri ma ma lus bsregs// zhes so// //re bzhi pa grub chen tsar+pa ṭi pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su grub chen tsar+pa ṭi pa sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ na bza' mi kha li zhes pa dbus kyi bug pa nas mgul bton cing*/ g.yas g.yon gyi phyed phyed mdun rgyab kyi na bza' bgos pa la sku rags bcings pa/ phyag gnyis bcud len gyi snod gser 'gyur gyi rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa las shing lo'i 'thor g.yab kyis gtor bas/

skyes pa bud med mtha' yas pa don chen po la yud kyis 'god pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs so// do ha ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa mchog /rang gis rtogs las gzhan med de// gnyug ma sems nyid rtogs pa gang*// sangs rgyas thams cad des mthong yin// ces so// //re lnga pa rnal 'byor ma ma ṇi bha dra ni/ mtha' klas pas brgyan pa'i dbus su/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ma chen mo ma ṇi bha drā bu mo gzhon nu ma lang tsho'i gang ba can shin tu mdzes pa'i mtshar sdug phun sum tshogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa nam mkha' la 'phur ba'i tshul can/ 'og gi sa gzhir chu bum chag pa la gzigs pa'i rnam pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs/ do ha ni/ gang zhig ma rtogs dus kyi tshe// rnam rtog sna tshogs sgra phyir 'breng*// de nyid rang bzhin mngon gyur tshe// gang snang rang bzhin de de nyid// ces so// //re drug pa rnal 'byor ma me kha li ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ma me kha li sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ gzhon mdzes lang tsho rgyas shing dbu skra sil bur grol ba/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan can/ mchan khung du rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bzung ba/ nam mkha' las ye shes kyi ral gri phyungs te phyag g.yas kyis 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis gar stabs brkyang bskum gyi tshul du bzhugs pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs/ do ha ni/ phyi dang nang kun sems su 'dus// zhen pa med na ro snyoms ldan// 'bad rtsol med na sgom pa'i mchog /gnyis med bde chen rdzogs sangs rgyas// zhes so// //re bdun pa rnal 'byor ma ka kha la ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su rnal 'byor ma ka na kha la sku mdog dkar dmar gcer mo lang tsho rgyas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ phyag g.yas pas ye shes kyi ral gri rno ngar ldan pa 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pas rang gi dbu bcad de 'dzin pa phag mo dbu bcad ma'i tshul ltar/

zhabs brkyang bskum gar stabs kyis nam mkha' la gar mdzad pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs/ do ha ni/ go cha chen po bgos nas kyang*// nor bu lta bu'i snying stobs kyis// rang gi sems kyi gru btang nas// mi ro'i khog par nges par zhugs// zhes so// //re brgyad pa ka la ka la pa ni/ gzhom du med pas yongs su bskor ba'i snying po dur khrod chen po'i sa gzhi 'jigs su rung ba'i dbus su/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ka la ka la pa/ sku sngo nag gcer bu ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa/ de'i mdun mtho ba na rnal 'byor dbang phyug rus rgyan can zhig gis chos ston pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs/ do ha ni/ chos dbyings rnam dag mkha' dkyil du// skye med 'brug sgra legs bsgrags pas// snang srid 'khrul pa'i chos rnams kun// sku gsum ye shes 'bras bu mdzes// zhes so// //re dgu pa kan+dha li pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su pags pa'i gdan la grub chen kan+dha li pa sku mdog sngo sangs ras kyi smad dkris can/ phyag gnyis khab skud dang bem po bsnams te tshem bu 'drub pa'i tshul can/ lhan cig sogs so// do ha ni/ bla ma dam pa'i khab dag dang*// snying rje yi ni skud pa yis// khams gsum ma lus gos su btsems// gos kyi rnal 'byor ngo mtshar che// zhes so// //bdun cu pa grub chen dha hu li pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su/ grub pa'i slob dpon dha hu li pa sku mdog sngo sangs ral pa'i thor tshugs cung zad dang bcas pa/ ras kyi smad dkris can g.yon nas rig mas 'dud cing*/ rtsa thag gi grims pa'i khur po 'chos pa'i tshul can/ lhan cig sogs/ do ha ni/ zung 'jug rig pa rin chen mdzod// gnyis med ngang der btsal bas min// bya ba btang ba'i sems bzhin du// ji ltar bzhag pa de ltar bde// zhes so// //don gcig pa u dhi li pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su gos stan bzang po la bzhugs pa'i slob dpon grub pa thob pa'i u dhi li pa sku mdog dkar smug sha nyams can sma ra bzang po dang ldan pa/

gos phu dung can gsol zhing dbu la ras kyi thod bcing sogs khyim bdag gi cha byad/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ spyan nam mkha' la gzigs pa/ nam mkha'i mthongs su sprin kha dog sna lnga glang po che dang*/ rta dang*/ bya la sogs pa'i gzugs brnyan 'char ba dang*/ bya ngang pa nam mkha' la 'phur ba/ de'i mdun du rnal 'byor pa shing lo thogs pa zhig gis chos 'chad pa'i tshul can/ lhan cig sogs/ do ha ni/ ji ltar rnam rtog rjes 'brang 'khrul// ma 'breng bag chags ma btang bzung*// gang la mi gnas 'gro ba bsdu// gzhan las btsal bas de rnyed min// ces so// //don gnyis pa ka pā la pa ni/ yongs su bskor ba'i snying por dur khrod kyi sa gzhi 'jigs su rung ba'i dbus su grub chen ka pā li pa rnal 'byor ba'i cha byad sku mdog sngo nag 'doms dkris ma gtogs gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ mdun du bud med bzang mo'i ro bzhag pa'i thod pa bregs te phyag tu bsnams pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs/ do ha ni/ dngos kun gnyis med rdo rje 'dzin// rgyan sogs thod pa glo bur ba// ngar 'dzin 'khrul pa de nyid kyang*// rang gis btsal bas rnyed ma yin// ces so// //don gsum pa ki ra ba la pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su rin po che'i stan la grub pa'i slob dpon ki ra ba la sku mdog dkar smug cung zad khro bo'i nyams ldan/ sma ra bzang po can/ dbu la cod pan dbus phyogs bzhi ste rtse mo lnga pa rin po che'i tog can gsol pa/ skra mtshams su dpa' bo'i dar dpyangs zhes pa rin chen gser gyi 'khyud mo las rna ltag g.yas g.yon nas mar dar dpyangs 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas ral gri dang*/ g.yon phub bzung ste rol stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs so// do ha ni/ ji srid ma rtogs bar du rang gzhan rtogs pas bcings// de tshe rtogs par gyur na rang gzhan gnyis ma grub// des na sangs rgyas zhes bya rang gi bla dwags yin// de nyid spros bral ma bcos rang sar rang sems zung*/

zhes so// //don bzhi pa grub chen sa ka ra pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su slob dpon chen po sa ka ra pa dge slong gi cha byad/ chos gos rnam pa gsum dang ldan pa/ mdun na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sku bzhengs stabs kyis bzhugs pa la gus pas mchod pa'i tshul/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs/ do ha ni/ 'gro rnams sdug bsngal gyis gdungs la// 'dod yon dag gi char phab bo// de bzhin nyid kyi gnas chen du// rig pa'i klu rgyal nyid gzir nas// skal ldan rig 'dzin pho mo la// gsang sngags rig pa'i char phab bo// zhes so// //don lnga pa sarba bhak+ṣa pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su/ grub pa'i dbang phyug sarba bhak+ṣa pa sku sngo sangs dmangs rigs kyi cha byad ras kyi 'doms dkris/ skra bcings pa/ mdun du snod gcig gi nang zas bzang ngan sna tshogs yod pa longs spyod pa'i tshul can/ lhan cig sogs/ do ha ni/ bdag gis ma rtogs dus na sna tshogs ro la khyad par che// gang zhig rtogs pa'i dus su ro rnams ngo bo bye brag med// de bzhin ma rtogs nyid na 'khor 'das tha dad snang*// de nyid rtogs na 'khor ba sangs rgyas bde ba che// zhes so// //don drug pa nā ga bo dhi ni/ dbus su dge sbyong gi yo byad gding ba'i stan la slob dpon chen po nā ga bo dhi'am klu'i byang chub sku mdog mi sha kha sngo sangs dge slong gi tshul can phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad cing ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs/ do ha ni/ sa la gnas na thams cad skal pa bzang*// rgya mtsho'i gting du phyin na dbul dang bral// ral gri lag tu thogs na longs spyod che// phyogs med dag tu phyin na gnyen dang 'phrad// ces so// //don bdun pa grub chen dā ri ka pa ni/ dbus su grub pa'i dbang phyug dā ri ka pa sku sngo sangs/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsnams zhing 'ja' 'od dang bcas nam mkha' la 'phur zhing lding ba'i tshul gyis gshegs pa/

'khor du mchog tu gyur pa'i bud med gzugs dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa bsam mi khyab pa dang bcas mkha' spyod du bgrod pa'i tshul can/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs/ do ha ni/ bde ba chen po rang la yod kyang ma rtogs 'khrul pas bsgribs// bde gsal 'dod pas bsod nams ye shes tshogs bsag bya// tshogs gnyis ma bsags skye ba brgya ru 'bad byas kyang*// bla ma dag dang mi ldan bde ba chen po rtogs mi 'gyur// ces so// //don brgyad pa pu ta li ba ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su kṛṣ+ṇa sā ra'i pags pa'i gdan la slob dpon pu ta li pa rnal 'byor gyi cha byad dbu skra co bregs/ sgom thag dang ang rag gsol pa/ mdun du dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i sku ras bris pa bkram pa la rtse gcig tu gzigs pa/ lhan cig sogs// do ha ni/ thams cad bde gshegs rang bzhin te// blos bzhag log pa'i lam spangs te// snying po'i lam la brtson byas pas// snying po'i 'bras bu gdon mi za// gang gi bla ma dam pa las// dbang blangs lhan cig skyes pa de// ro yis kun la khyab byas te// skye med rgyas 'debs rdo rje 'dzin// ces so// //don dgu pa u pa na ha pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su grub chen u pa na ha sku mdog dkar sngo ras kyi smad dkris dang thod can/ phyag gnyis dkur brten pa/ ag tshom dang bcas shing*/ zhabs la l+h+wam yu bcad g.yer kha sogs rgyan mang po btags te sil khrol gyi sgra dang bcas rgyugs pa'i tshul gyis/ bde chen gyi sar rings par 'gro ba la brtson dgos pa'i brda ston pa/ lhan cig sogs/ do ha ni/ snying po gnyug ma'i don bsams pas// ji ltar bsam pa de ltar rtogs// des ni de nyid rang dgar yin// 'dod rgu lhug par thams cad 'byung*// zhes so// brgyad cu pa grub chen ko ki la pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su slob dpon chen po ko ki la pa rgyal po'i cha byad sku mdog dkar dmar/

dar zab kyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rin po che'i khri stan la bzhugs pa'i mtha' skor du skyed mos tshal 'bras bu can gyi shing gis gang ba/ gzhon nu ma mchog gi mdzes sdug can mang pos glu dang gar dang*/ rlung g.yab dang*/ khrus gsol ba'i rnam pa/ shing rnams la bya ko ki la ste khu byug nag po mang po snyan pa'i sgra 'byin pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs/ do ha ni/ bya ba btang na man ngag yin// zhe 'dod med pa rtogs pa yin// bde ba dngos med sgom pa yin// bsgrub bya med na 'bras bu'i mchog /ces so// //gya gcig pa a naṅga pa ni/ dbus su slob dpon a naṅga pa sku dkar dmar shin tu mdzes pa lta bas chog mi shes pa zhabs skyil krung*/ phyag mnyam gzhag dang sa gnon gyi tshul gyis ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag bzhin rtswa yi spyil por gnas pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs/ do ha ni/ 'khor ba snying po med pa yi// 'ja' tshon lta bu'i lus 'di la// ma rig mngon zhen dregs pa yis// dug gis zin nas bde bar 'dzin// mngon zhen dug nad spangs pa na// 'khor ba nyid kyang chos kyi sku// zhes so// //gya gnyis pa rnal 'byor ma lak+ṣ+mī ka ba ni/ phyi rim srung ba'i 'khor lo gzhom du med pas yongs su bskor ba'i snying po dur khrod chen po 'jigs su rung ba'i gnas su/ mi ro'i gdan la rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang mo chen mo lak+ṣ+mī ka ra sku mdog dkar dmar bde ba'i nyams mchog tu rgyas pa'i lang tsho'i gang ba can/ mdzes sdug gi phul du phyin pa/ sku gcer mo nu 'bur dang bha ga rgyas pa/ khro 'dzum chags pa'i nyams ldan/ phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ mchan khung du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams zhing rus pa'i rgyan gyis mdzes pa/ zhabs brkyang bskum rol stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs/ do ha ni/ dang por blo ldan rtogs pa skyed// bar du gnas lugs ma yengs sgom// de nas nyams myong skyes pa na// spyod pa bags kyis spyad par bya// zhes so//

//gya gsum pa sa mu dra pa ni/ bskor ba'i dbus su/ rgya mtsho chen po gting dpag dka' bar gru bo che mtho khyad phun sum tshogs pa nor bu rin po ches yongs su gang ba'i nang du/ grub pa'i slob dpon sa mu dra pa sku mdog dkar dmar ded dpon gyi cha byad gos tso ma dang thod bcings/ zhabs phyed krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'khor du mas bskor ba/ steng gi nam mkha' la grub thob a tsin+ta pa gcer bu ral pa can gyis chos ston pa/ lhan cig sogs/ do ha ni/ skye med rtogs kyang nyams myong dang bral na// dper na srin mo'i lag tu bu khyer 'dra// nyams myong gnas lugs dag dang ma 'brel na// de yang glang chen 'dam du zhugs pa 'dra// zhes so// //gya bzhi pa byā li pa ni/ brgyan pa'i dbus su pags pa'i gdan la grub pa'i dbang phyug byā li pa sku mdog dkar dmar nor bu'i kha dog ltar 'od zer 'bar ba bram ze'i cha byad tshangs skud dkar po phrag par thogs pa/ ras kyi smad dkris gsol ba/ phyag gnyis bcud len gyi snod thogs shing*/ sku'i nye logs su gser 'gyur gyi rtsis gang ba'i gzhong pa dang*/ lcags mang po gser du bsgyur ba'i rnam pa can/ sku'i g.yon phyogs su chung ma bu dang mna' mar bcas pa/ mdun du rta mchog ste thams cad rig pa 'dzin pa'i lus can rgyan gyis spras pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs/ do ha ni/ bla ma dam pa mthong na de nyid mthong*// nam mkha'i mthongs su bsgoms na dben pa'i mchog /chos rnams yongs su rtogs na mi mthun med// nam mkha'i 'o ma 'thung na 'tsho bar 'gyur// zhes so// //de lta grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi ba'i byin rlabs bya tshul spyi chings sngon bshad la bsgyur kha bkod pa rnams shes par byas/ bar 'dir/ yi dam mtshon byed rdo rje gdan pa'i lugs mi g.yo sngon po'i rjes gnang bya ste de ni sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas nang las 'byung bzhin bya ba nyid yin no// mthar bka' srung chos skyong gi byin rlabs ni/

maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du gtor ma gru gsum nag po'am/ dpal gtor snying gzugs pad 'dab bzhi pa rgyan can gtor gdugs kyis mtshan pa mañdzir bkod/ mchod tshogs bshams/ de yang snang gzhi mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal zhes pa nas/ gzhom du med pas yongs su bskor ba'i snying por dur khrod kyi sa gzhi 'jigs su rung ba'i dbus su pad+ma nyi ma dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i bam ro'i gdan la dpal ye shes kyi mgon po nag po chen po sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin dang mun pa ltar nag pa/ sbom zhing thung la gsus pa 'phyang ba/ yan lag rags pa/ drag por khros pa'i zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ spyan gsum me stag ltar dmar zhing zlum la g.yo ba/ sma ra smin ma ag tshom dmar ser me 'phro ba/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas kyi dang pos mchog sbyin/ gnyis pa na ral gri me 'bar ba/ g.yon gyi dang pos thod khrag gnyis pas rtse gsum dar dpyangs ḍa ma ru dang ldan pa 'phyar ba/ rdo rje nag po'i rtse phran gyi mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal gdug pa'i sbrul dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs/ zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum rol stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ ye shes kyi me phung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad pa'i he ru ka dpal chen drag po'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i tshul du rol pa/ srid gsum dregs pa kun gyis 'dud bzhin pa'i spyan sngar khyed rang rnams kyi sku lus rnam smin gyi sogs nas/ legs sbyar 'di ni rje btsun nag po cher// dad pas phul ba'i sogs dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra sogs bsgyur/ phyag 'tshal skabs/ gang gi 'phrul dang mngon par mkhyen pa'i dpal// nye bar thob nas rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin du// bstan pa rin chen bang mdzod legs skyong ba'i// rdo rje chos skyong mchog la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ de ltar dad mos gdung shugs drag pos phyag 'tshal zhing gsol ba 'debs par mdzad pa'i rkyen gyis/

dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i dpral ba nas sogs nas/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i bar sngar gyi bzhin rigs 'gre/ slar yang mos gdung drag pos gsol ba btab pas dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i sku 'od phung gi rnam par ltem gyis zhu nas khyed rang la thim pas sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi byin rlabs thams cad la mnga' brnyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ maṇ+ḍal gyi tshab gtor ma mgo bor bzhag nas/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po sogs rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam tshig gi rim pa las ma 'da' bar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ sems can gyi bde skyid spel/ bye brag tu rdo rje slob ma 'di nyid dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad las srungs shig mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad sol cig mthu rkyen thams cad sgrubs shig spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang bye brag rig pa 'dzin pa 'di nyid la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i phrin las mdzod cig mdor na rig pa 'dzin pa 'di'i chos ldan bsam pa yid bzhin du 'grub pa dang*/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsol bar mdzad du gsol/ snying po dang*/ rtsa sngags shā sa na sogs brjod cing*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbarjod/ des 'phags yul grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi yi dam bka' srung gi mtha' rten dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs kyi rim pa chad lhag nor pa'i skyon med pa/ 'phags yul grub pa'i bzhed gzhung mkhas mchog grub pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis gtan la phab pa'i dgongs don bzhin legs par phul grub pa yin pas rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig thams cad ma nyams par bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ deng nas brtsams te sogs/ de lta bu'i dge ba mkha' mnyam sems can gyi don du bsngo ba 'di nyid lhan cig tu gnang bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod do// de nas tshogs mchod ni/ bza' ba dang bca' ba dam tshig gi rdzas ji snyed pa tshogs par byas la nang mchod kyi bdud rtsis bran/ oṃ suṃ bhas bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyang*/ tshogs rdzas rnams mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du 'gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las tshogs rdzas rnams kyi 'og tu yam̐ las rlung ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du āḥlas ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i tshogs rdzas zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ na mo thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po rang bzhin rnam par dag pa skye ba med pa/ mtshan nyid rnam par dag pa ā li kā li/ ngo bo rnam par dag pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas rgyas btab pa 'di nyid/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du ga ṇa tsakra pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ na mo thabs dang shes rab= nas/ rgyas btab pa 'di nyid/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du= sogs/ na mo nas/ 'di nyid phrin las kyi rtsa ba mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi= na mo nas/ 'di nyid dam tshig gi rtsa ba mched grogs rdo rje spun grogs rnams kyi zhal du= sogs/ slar yang byin 'bebs ni/ dbyings bde gsal mi rtog pho brang cher// rje rdo rje 'chang chen 'gro ba'i mgon// de rang la snang ba skyabs kyi gtso// pha drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma yang*// khyed rnam 'phrul mkha' la sprin bzhin gtibs// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// gnas khang 'di la byin phob la// tshogs gtor 'di la bcud cig chug

/'dir 'dus rnal 'byor bdag cag la// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// oṃ ma hā gu ru a shī ti ka sid+dhi la b+dha dz+nyā na ā be sha ya a āḥ yul dbus 'gyur ma ga dhā yi char// ma 'gro ba'i don du sku bltams pa'i// rje rnal 'byor dbang phyug grub pa'i tshogs// khyed rnam 'phrul= 'dir gshegs= gnas= tshogs= 'dir 'dus= mchog dang= oṃ= yul rgya gar shar phyogs yul ljongs su// ma 'gro ba'i don= sogs gong ltar rigs 'gre/ yul rgya gar lho phyogs yul ljongs su// ma 'gro ba'i= sogs/ yul rgya gar nub phyogs yul ljongs// ma 'gro ba'i= yul rgya gar byang phyogs yul ljongs su// ma 'gro ba'i= sogs// rigs rgyal rigs bram ze rje'u'i rigs// 'bangs dmangs rigs phal par sku 'khrungs pa'i// rje rnal 'byor dbang phyug sogs// yab rnal 'byor dbang po mtha' yas kyi// ma lhan cig spyod pa gsang ba'i yum// srid dga' bzhi'i nyams ster thams cad kyang*// khyed rnams 'phrul sogs/ pho rtogs shing grol ba brgyad cu dang*// mo rtogs shing grol ba'i sring mo bzhi// rje grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i tshogs// khyed rnam 'phrul mkha' la sprin bzhin sogs/ stug po'i zhing khams 'jigs med par// dpa' bo dpa' mo 'bum sde'i dbus// rdo rje gtum po mi g.yo mgon// bcom ldan he ru ka pa yang*// rnam 'phrul= zhes nas/ gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni dz+nyā na ā be sha ya a āḥ mi g.yo 'og min nyams dga'i zhing*// dag pa bde stong mkha' spyod gnas// rgyal ba dgyes pa'i bde skyed yum// rdo rje phag mo mkha' 'gro'i gtso// rnam 'phrul mkha' la= /bdud tshogs kun 'dul phrin las zhing*// dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas// bgegs 'joms 'dod don kun sgrub pa'i// dpal ldan mgon po lcam dral yang*// rnam 'phrul mkha' la sprin= /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// rigs kyi cod pan ldems se ldems// dar gyi con pan pu ru ru// rgyan cha mang po khrol lo lo// rol mo mang po dir ri ri// glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug

/'khor tshogs 'bum sde shar ra ra// sgyu ma'i rang snang rjen ne ne// gtad med rig pa gsal la la// brjod med dbyings su thal la la// bde ba chen por khril li li// byin gyis rlob phyir gshegs su gsol// gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la// sgrub mchog bdag la dngos grub stsol// bgegs dang log 'dren bar chod sol// 'khor gsum gnyis su med par 'dres// gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni dz+nyā na ā be shā ya a āḥ las kyi rdo rjes lag g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzung*/ g.yas rtse gsum phyag rgyas steng 'og kha sbyor du bzung ste/ 'dir ni chos rnams bzang por ltos// 'dus pa rnams la them tshom med// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa gsum// rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol// a ho ma hā su khaṃ/ tshogs kyi gtso bo nas brtsams te bskor/ de dag gis/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med// 'dod chags la sogs dri ma bral// gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba// de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal// a ho ma hā su khaṃ/ tshogs phud 'bul ba ni/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan pas yid 'phrog pa// legs sbyar 'di ni bla ma lha tshogs la// dad pas phul bas 'gro ba 'di dag gis// 'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog /oṃ ma hā gu ru sid+dhi lab+dha bud+dha bo dhi sa twa wī ra ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥn maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsogs= ba liṃ ta swā hā/ oṃ a kā ro btags pa lan bdun gyis bla ma grub thob 'khor bcas dang*/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis mi g.yo ba dang*/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya shā sa na sogs nas/ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa kyis mgon po chos skyong tshogs la 'bul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥpheṃ badz+ra ā ral+li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ oṃ kha kha sogs/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ltar gyis mgron gzhan rnams la phul/
